ground_truth.reference_condition: controlled overhead photo, whole plank visible, no tape measure

second_pass_findings: Camera height did not solve Yardarm; confidence decreased on the controlled 32-inch image.
Absolute scale cannot be inferred from unreferenced pixels alone.
The classifier must isolate the plank silhouette independently from frame occupancy and scene background.
Cross-erosion is required to prevent skinny warm bridges from attaching unrelated scene regions to the plank.
acceptance_rule: A normal customer photo may auto-resolve 2 ft only when the grown silhouette clears calibrated ratio, shape-stability, background-separation, framing, orientation, overlap, and boundary-distance gates. Camera height is not a customer requirement.
future_calibration: 4 ft and 6 ft require real known-stock examples before one-photo auto-resolution is allowed.
